The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 de92d884cd5298c4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 26-27. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix ϕ ∈ {−7π/8, −π/8}. Let Sraw(N, ϕ) denote the confluent raw sum just considered. With E(y) = y2 /(2Hb), f0 = −ϕ/(2π), R = dMb (a)/dO(a) = (2k/3)2 / √ 2k (the last by the row formulas), define FN (ϕ) = Sraw(N, ϕ) |w|N RN2 N7/16−12E(f0) . 26 There is a locally finite set Γϕ ⊂ Q≥0, containing 0, and fixed polynomials Pϕ,γ such that, for every desired accuracy J > 0, one can choose AJ > J with FN (ϕ) = X γ∈Γϕ γ≤AJ N−γ Pϕ,γ(log N) + Oϕ,J (N−J ) for every sufficiently large integer N. The coefficient polynomials are the same for all truncations and all integers N; no subsequence or parity choice is made. The polynomial at γ = 0 is a constant, which may at this stage vanish. For ϕ = −π/8, every positive rate is at least 1.
